clauses.text: 1. Purpose

source_location.excerpt: 1. Purpose

clauses.text: The purpose of this policy is to define operational and technical security controls to protect Primevolta Hardware Solutions’ information assets and client data, particularly for BFSI clients like FinSecure Services. This policy supports compliance with international standards (ISO 27001, SOC2, PCI DSS where applicable) and ensures robust measures for confidentiality, integrity, availability, and privacy of data.

source_location.excerpt: The purpose of this policy is to define operational and technical security controls to protect Primevolta Hardware Solutions’ information assets and client data, particularly for BFSI clients like FinSecure Services. This policy supports compliance with international standards (ISO 27001, SOC2, PCI DSS where applicable) and ensures robust measures for confidentiality, integrity, availability, and privacy of data.

clauses.text: It establishes operational procedures, monitoring mechanisms, incident response workflows, and reporting standards to minimize risks associated with cyber threats, data breaches, and regulatory non-compliance.

source_location.excerpt: It establishes operational procedures, monitoring mechanisms, incident response workflows, and reporting standards to minimize risks associated with cyber threats, data breaches, and regulatory non-compliance.

clauses.text: Systems containing financial, customer, or regulated data, including cardholder information subject to PCI DSS.

clauses.text: 3.1 Executive Responsibilities

source_location.excerpt: 3.1 Executive Responsibilities

clauses.text: CEO: Approves overall information security strategy and critical incidents.

clauses.text: CISO: Oversees policy implementation, monitoring, risk assessment, and continuous improvement.

source_location.excerpt: 3.2 Operational Responsibilities

clauses.text: IT Security Team: Implements technical controls, monitors security events, and manages incident response.

source_location.excerpt: IT Security Team: Implements technical controls, monitors security events, and manages incident response.

clauses.text: Compliance Team: Ensures alignment with ISO 27001, SOC2, PCI DSS, and BFSI regulatory requirements.

source_location.excerpt: Compliance Team: Ensures alignment with ISO 27001, SOC2, PCI DSS, and BFSI regulatory requirements.

clauses.text: Department Heads: Ensure team adherence to security processes and report non-compliance.

clauses.text: 3.3 Vendor/Third-Party Obligations

source_location.excerpt: 3.3 Vendor/Third-Party Obligations

clauses.text: Vendors must comply with contractual security requirements and participate in periodic audits.

source_location.excerpt: Vendors must comply with contractual security requirements and participate in periodic audits.

clauses.text: Non-compliance triggers corrective actions, including potential contract termination.

clauses.text: 4. Information Security Risk Management

source_location.excerpt: 4. Information Security Risk Management

clauses.text: Conduct annual risk assessments to identify threats, vulnerabilities, and potential impacts.

source_location.excerpt: Conduct annual risk assessments to identify threats, vulnerabilities, and potential impacts.

clauses.text: Classify risks as high, medium, or low and apply controls proportionate to risk.

source_location.excerpt: Classify risks as high, medium, or low and apply controls proportionate to risk.

clauses.text: Implement a continuous monitoring program using SIEM, IDS/IPS, and anomaly detection tools.

source_location.excerpt: Implement a continuous monitoring program using SIEM, IDS/IPS, and anomaly detection tools.

clauses.text: Maintain a risk register documenting risk assessment results, mitigation plans, and assigned responsibilities.

clauses.text: Role-based access control (RBAC) enforced across all systems.

source_location.excerpt: Role-based access control (RBAC) enforced across all systems.

clauses.text: Sensitive data encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest (AES-256).

clauses.text: Firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, and network segmentation protect internal and client systems.

source_location.excerpt: Firewalls, VPNs, IDS/IPS, and network segmentation protect internal and client systems.

clauses.text: Routine vulnerability scanning and penetration testing performed quarterly.

clauses.text: Logging of all network access and security events for 12 months minimum.

clauses.text: Mobile devices managed under MDM policy, enforcing encryption and remote wipe.
